text:
alex: Quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today

What I did: triaged /embed-service alerts, rolled back canary to v2.1, added a smoke check to CI (simple curl to /health).
Blocker: intermittent 503s hitting Redis primary after failover; still reproducing (~1/1000 requests). Need infra help to look at networking/iptables.
Today: follow up with infra, finish runbook draft for latency SLO throttles, review PR #412 (rate-limiter).

priya: Thanks Alex. FYI I ran `redis-cli --latency` on the cluster — latency spikes correlate with evictions. I'll open a ticket with node metrics.

dan: oncall here — I acked the pager this morning, looks like the majority of 5xxs are from a new GC config on the cache layer. I reverted the JVM flags on prod-canary, monitoring for 30m.

katie: Left a note in the runbook draft re: when to shift traffic to Dedicated. Minor nit on the escalation path.

oncall-bot: Alert: /embed-service 5xx rate > threshold (5m avg) — triggered 1763102460. Pager acknowledged by dan.

priya: I'll attach heap snapshots and eviction counts to the ticket. Also adding the metric query we used:
```
sum(rate(redis_evicted_keys_total[5m])) by (instance)
```

alex: Thx — can someone paste the current SLO burn rate for embedding-api? I want to decide if we should burn budget to chase perf or mitigate with fallback.

dan: embedding-api error budget: 84% remaining for current period. 99p latency SLO is 260ms and is at 285ms during spikes.

katie: Small ask — can we get a quick postmortem template from eng-sre wiki populated? I'll start the doc and tag owners.

alex: sounds good. Blocker assigned to priya + infra. I'll handle PR review after lunch. Ping me if redis ticket needs escalation :thumbsup:

priya: noted. Adding logs + pcap to the ticket now.

dan: leaving periodic check 12:00, will re-evaluate at 12:40. :spiral_calendar:

katie: no further blockers from me.
